turns.user: What does the term causal mechanism mean? Give a brief definition and one example. Do not brainstorm alternatives.
turns.assistant:
A causal mechanism is the process or chain of events through which one factor produces an effect.

Example: Smoking causes lung cancer partly because chemicals in tobacco damage lung cells, leading to mutations and uncontrolled cell growth.
